rules.currency_policy: Rank only comparable values within one currency; do not FX-convert implicitly.
rules.identity_policy: Aggregate only by source-native/canonical stable entity IDs. Names and normalized names are display/discovery fields only.
rules.measure_policy: Awarded, obligated, disbursed, paid, assessed, claimed, judgment, contributed, loaned, guaranteed, incentivized and estimated values are non-equivalent measures.
rules.tie_policy: Use competition ranking by metric value; deterministic entity_id ordering is display-only and never evidence of superiority.
rules.top_n_policy: Top N includes every entity tied at rank N.
rules.unresolved_policy: Records lacking a stable entity binding never silently contribute to a canonical entity total.
